title: TopTimeNet: Topologically-assisted time-series classification model
abstract: arXiv:2609.39792v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Distinguishing periodic from chaotic dynamics in a time series is a fundamental challenge in both physics and engineering. Yet, end-to-end learned architectures must discover both a representation and a decision boundary from data, at substantial cost. We introduce TopTimeNet, which decouples these tasks: a fixed, non-learned stage extracts a $42$-dimensional geometric and topological descriptor from Takens delay embeddings and persistent homology, and a lightweight learnable stage performs classification. On a benchmark of $49$ nonlinear dynamical systems, a $1{,}638$-parameter configuration matches the mean accuracy of one with $33\times$ more trainable parameters. Additionally, this approach delivers mean accuracy comparable to convolutional neural networks and surpasses the average performance of converged Transformer models, while requiring three to four orders of magnitude fewer trainable parameters. translated_title: TopTimeNet：拓扑辅助的时间序列分类模型
translated_abstract: 区分时间序列中的周期性动力学与混沌动力学是物理学和工程学中的一项根本性挑战。然而，端到端学习的架构必须从数据中同时发现表示和决策边界，代价高昂。我们提出了TopTimeNet，它将这两项任务解耦：一个固定的、非学习的阶段从Takens延迟嵌入和持续同调中提取42维几何与拓扑描述符，再由一个轻量级的可学习阶段执行分类。在包含49个非线性动力系统的基准测试中，一个仅有1,638个参数的配置达到了可训练参数多33倍的模型所能达到的平均准确率。此外，该方法提供的平均准确率与卷积神经网络相当，并超越了已收敛的Transformer模型的平均性能，同时所需的可训练参数少了三到四个数量级。鲁棒性也严重依赖于……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: TopTimeNet通过将基于Takens延迟嵌入和持续同调的固定拓扑特征提取与轻量级可学习分类器解耦，仅用1,638个参数就在区分周期与混沌动力学上达到与参数多33倍的模型及CNN相当、并超越Transformer的性能。
en_tdlr: TopTimeNet decouples fixed topological feature extraction (via Takens delay embeddings and persistent homology) from a lightweight learnable classifier, achieving accuracy comparable to models with 33× more parameters and to CNNs—and surpassing Transformers—while requiring three to four orders of magnitude fewer trainable parameters.
